FDA approval of lymphoma medicine Ukoniq (umbralisib) is withdrawn due to safety concerns

Possible increased risk of death outweighs the benefits

This is an update to the FDA Drug Safety Communication: FDA investigating possible increased risk of death with lymphoma medicine Ukoniq (umbralisib) issued on February 3, 2022.

Español 药物安全通讯 Drug Safety Podcast

Drug Safety Communication (PDF - 197 KB)

6-1-2022 FDA Drug Safety Communication

Due to safety concerns, the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has withdrawn its approval for the cancer medicine Ukoniq (umbralisib). Ukoniq was approved to treat two specific types of lymphoma: marginal zone lymphoma (MZL) and follicular lymphoma (FL).
